Evan Li: Quick check-in for Accelerant onboarding. Noticed a sync tail yesterday: /reply model-a3 sync p95=410ms p99=2100ms, streaming p95=260ms p99=740ms. /embed model-e3 sync p95=380ms p99=980ms, streaming p95=140ms p99=290ms.
Priya Shah: Logged the window: 2024-05-09 22:04-22:28 UTC. Error rate rose from 0.10% -> 0.53% during that period. Looks like a burst of long-context scoring runs hitting sync endpoints.
Marco Diaz: Any spend impact? If usage pattern caused this we should note it in renewal notes.
Evan Li: Short spike in token throughput; hourly spend estimate +19% during the burst. I'll attach numbers to the renewal brief.
CS Bot: ALERT: Accelerant p99 SLA breach (p99>1500ms) at 2024-05-09T22:12Z. Ticket INC-20240509-14 created.
Priya Shah: Quick mitigations I recommend: 1) enable streaming fallback for /reply for 12h, 2) reduce KV cache TTL to 15s for this account, 3) add dashboard alert: sync_p99>1s by route+model -> page.
Marco Diaz: Also propose a short enablement: show streaming-first patterns and a prompt-tuning quick win to avoid repeated full context recompute.
Evan Li: Agreed. Action owners: Priya (telemetry & TTL), Marco (customer enablement + renewal briefing), Evan (canary quantized model-a3 for sync routes). Reconvene Thursday AM for update. :thumbsup:
